dailyLimit.title: Daily play limit
dailyLimit.common: Not applied to the common tenant
dailyLimit.note: Applies to every student of the school, on the total game time of the day (Vietnam time). At the limit students are warned, their session ends and they can come back from 00:00 the next day.

installers.intro: The latest production Android kits (APK) for the grades of the school, to distribute through MDM or USB. There is no Windows installer: lab PCs play the Web version.

installers.noSchool: There is no active school in your scope.
installers.empty: There is no kit for the grades of the school yet.
installers.shaHelp: After downloading, compare the SHA-256 of the file with the value in the table before installing.
installers.copyFailed: Could not copy. Select the SHA-256 and copy it by hand.

web.title: Web version for lab PCs
web.description: Lab PCs need no installation: open the Web version in a browser with WebGL 2 (a recent Chrome, Edge or Firefox). Students sign in again each time they open the game.
web.supported: This browser supports WebGL 2: the Web version can be played.
web.unsupported: This browser does not support WebGL 2 or graphics acceleration is off. Use a recent Chrome, Edge or Firefox and turn on hardware acceleration.

deviceCfg.title: device.cfg for shared Android tablets
deviceCfg.intro: The school MDM pushes device.cfg to the app through managed configuration. Only shared tablets (class sets, labs) need it.
deviceCfg.sharedDevice: — set true on a shared device: no saved sign-in, no remembered username, leaving the game signs out and inactivity signs out. Set false on the personal device of one student.
deviceCfg.lanCache: — address of the content cache in the school LAN (optional). The app tries the LAN cache first, checks the SHA-256 of every package and falls back to the CDN on error. Leave empty when the school has no LAN cache.
deviceCfg.note: Android devices only. The Web version does not read device.cfg.
